description: Facilities for Wildland Fire Protection is a dataset listed in State of California open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by CAL FIRE. This dataset is intended to provide a statewide depiction of CALFIRE and contract facilities for fire suppression. Coverage: California. The portal files it under the publisher CAL FIRE. Its tags are boundaries and ownership, cal fire, california, california department of forestry and fire protection, facilities. It offers 6 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ca-portal.
